people.rememberedBy: Lorna Goldberg; Scott and Christy Goldberg; Michael and Tiffany Goldberg; Evan, Ayla, Blake, and Mackenzie Goldberg; Nancy and Bill Aldredge
people.biography: Harvey J. Goldberg (January 8, 1947 – September 16, 2023) grew up in Framingham, Massachusetts, and raised his family in Peabody. He attended Wentworth Institute of Technology and Bentley College, enjoyed baseball, hockey, basketball, and bowling, and was remembered for his laughter and humor. He and his wife, Lorna (Linsky) Goldberg, were married for 53 years. Their sons are Scott and Michael Goldberg. His obituary names Temple Tifereth Israel of Peabody among the organizations to which memorial contributions could be made.

people.biography: Elliot Hershoff (1934 or 1935–2024) was a longtime leader of Congregation Tifereth Israel in Peabody, serving as its president for 18 years. Born in Boston to Abraham and Bessie (Sochin) Hershoff, he lived in Peabody and had previously lived in Roxbury. Elliot and his wife, Doris (Yonis) Hershoff, shared 66 years of marriage. He served in the United States Army National Guard and was involved with the Jewish War Veterans, Knights of Pythias, Mount Tabor Lodge, and Friends of the Senior Center in Peabody. He was the father of Randy Hershoff and Ronda Middleton, and was remembered by his grandchildren and great-grandchildren.

people.biography: SHELLEY (nee Targan). Our beloved Shelley lost her courageous battle with cancer on October 14, 2016, at the age of 70. Daughter of the late Samuel and Sarah Targan. Wife of the late Jerome Schorr. Cherished mother of Steven Berkowitz, Miriam (Phillip) Blue, and the late Stuart Berkowitz; stepmother of Brian (Jill) Schorr and Jeffrey Schorr. Twin sister of Rabbi Judith (Martin) Abrahamson and the late Robert (Sheila) Targan. Amazing Bubbie to Talia, Sophie and Mason. Loving aunt of Sari (Kevin), Lauren, Michele (Stuart), and Eric. Devoted great aunt, cousin, and friend.
